shared_elements: figures standing/walking in a row facing the same direction
low relief carving with incised interior detail
justification: Both show profile human figures in a processional/offering arrangement, one holding a vertical staff, combined with horned animals and organized within a band or register, which is a moderately specific shared scheme. The biggest differences are that A depicts a naturalistic secular procession of bearded attendants leading large rams in a continuous frieze with detailed hair and fleece patterning, while B shows a schematic, rigidly frontal-shouldered pair of divine/human figures with a horned solar headdress flanking columns of sign-like inscription under an arched winged emblem, with no animal being led and no repeated attendants.
